## About
Lukeri Studio is a premium digital craftsmanship studio specializing in Flutter development, mobile applications, and UI/UX design. Based in Istanbul and Bursa, Turkey, we create high-performance digital products for next-generation industry leaders.

## Services
- Flutter & Dart Development
- Cross-Platform Mobile Applications
- Premium UI/UX Design
- BLE & IoT Systems Integration
- Cloud Architecture (Firebase, Cloud Functions)
- Enterprise Systems Development

## Expertise
- Clean Architecture & SOLID Principles
- Riverpod & BLoC State Management
- Real-time Synchronization
- Offline-First Applications
- CI/CD Automation (CodeMagic, GitHub Actions)
